north_star: Multi-game creator assistant: turn long gameplay VODs into ranked short-form content opportunities for TikTok audience growth, then use that audience as a path toward livestreaming.
current_goal: Ship Creator Candidate Pack Beta (C1) across multiple gameplay archetypes before building AI rough editing (C2).

creator_roadmap.C1: Creator Candidate Pack Beta: multi-game VOD -> ranked creator-worthy candidates with setup/event/payoff and extracted source clips.
creator_roadmap.C2: AI Rough Editor on owner-selected candidates: tighten dead air, suggest hook, safe 9:16 reframe, draft subtitles, loudness cleanup, restrained punch-ins, hook/caption suggestions; preserve untouched candidate.

creator_roadmap.C4: Higher automation later: learned creator templates, batch drafts, export-ready packaging, optional publishing integration.
